question: Does the axisymmetric volume PEEC of the beak fin converge to the adaptive P2 axisymmetric FE reference?
milestone: Fin physical verdict: axisymmetric volume PEEC against the adaptive P2 reference
claim: Along boundary h 0.06, 0.04, 0.028 mm the PEEC errors in R, partial L, root and tip heat decrease strictly with log-ratio rate at least 1 and the finest error is at most 0.05.

conditions.problem: Beak fin, radius 200 mm, copper 5.8e7 S/m, 150 kHz, 1 A peak terminal current, exp(+j omega t)
conditions.mesh: Netgen meridian triangles, boundary h 0.06/0.04/0.028 mm, interior 0.5 mm, grading 0.25

comparison.reference: Adaptive P2 axisymmetric A_phi FE (order 2, exterior factor 3, 194275 DOFs)
comparison.independence: Differential FE route with an open exterior; no shared kernel or circuit solve

reference.citation: Adaptive axisymmetric A_phi finite elements (orders 1 and 2, exterior factors 1.5 and 3, ZZ indicator, Doerfler theta 0.5) run by validation_test/induction_heating/axisym_volume_peec_fin.py; the final level of order 2 at exterior factor 3 is the reference
reference.independence: A differential formulation with an open exterior on its own adaptive mesh; it shares no integral kernel, partial inductance or circuit solve with the PEEC route
shared_components: frequency, conductivity, radius and root/tip cut definitions

quantity.name: relative error of the fin terminal and regional quantities
quantity.definition: abs(Q_PEEC/Q_ref - 1) for Q in {R = Re(V/I), partial L = Im(V/I)/omega, root heat, tip heat}, per 1 A peak terminal current

variables.quantity_index: 1 = R, 2 = partial L, 3 = root heat (1.6 to 3.5 mm), 4 = tip heat (beyond 3.5 mm); held fixed within a series
variables.boundary_h_mm: Netgen edge size on the section boundary in mm; interior 0.5 mm and grading 0.25 fixed

expected_theory.model: Piecewise-constant ring currents on graded meridian triangles; first order in the boundary cell size is the user-approved lower bound (minimum rate 1)
expected_theory.norm: relative error of a scalar functional (equivalent R, partial L, root or tip heat per A^2) against the final adaptive P2 reference level; not an energy norm
expected_theory.source: Adaptive P2 axisymmetric A_phi reference resolved by validation_test/induction_heating/axisym_volume_peec_fin.py
expected_theory.assumptions: Fixed section, radius, sigma, frequency and drive; only the boundary edge size of the meridian mesh changes (interior 0.5 mm, grading 0.25); reference spread below one tenth of the 5 percent limit
expected_theory.limitations: Axisymmetric drive at 150 kHz only, skin depth about 0.17 mm; no 3D tetrahedral route, non-axisymmetric port, temperature dependence or other geometry is claimed

criterion.failure_definition: FAIL if any quantity's errors are not strictly decreasing over boundary h 0.06, 0.04, 0.028 mm, any adjacent log-ratio rate is below 1, any finest error exceeds 0.05, or any true relative residual exceeds 1e-6. An unresolved reference blocks adoption; a zero error is UNRESOLVED, never a rate.

rationale.inference: The axisymmetric volume PEEC converges to the resolved adaptive P2 reference on the beak fin for R, partial L, root and tip heat. This is a scoped adoption of the fin physical verdict, not a release qualification.
rationale.scope: Beak fin section at radius 200 mm, copper 5.8e7 S/m, 150 kHz, 1 A peak terminal current, axisymmetric drive.

assumptions.statement: Both orders and both exteriors converged inside budget and agree within one tenth of every limit (maximum spread R 0.31 %, L 0.03 %, root 0.31 %, tip 0.20 %).
assumptions.recheck: Rerun the four reference sequences after any change of the reference solver, section or settings.

assumptions.statement: Only the boundary edge size changes along each series; the P2 reference and the minimum rate 1 are user decisions of 2026-11-16.
assumptions.recheck: Reconsider on changed grading, interior size, frequency, geometry or refinement policy.

assumptions.statement: The reference is a differential FE route; the production PEEC route is not its own oracle.
assumptions.recheck: Check source, native and mesh identities before re-certification.

assumptions.statement: tests/test_ih_fin_peec_axisym_surrogate.py runs the production entry on the stored 0.06 mm mesh against its output at the recorded source with the user-approved rtol 1e-6; inductance x(1+1e-5) and conductivity x(1+1e-5) mutations both fail it, x(1+1e-6) mutations survive.
assumptions.recheck: Review coverage and mutation sensitivity after any baseline or fixture change; the lock tolerance (rtol 1e-6, atol 0, APPROVAL-20261116-FIN-PEEC-SURROGATE-TOL-01) is user-owned.

break_conditions.condition: reference solver, section, cuts or reference settings change
meshing parameters, frequency, material or drive change
source, native or mesh identity mismatch
surrogate fixture, baseline or tolerance change
